'''Blue Squad''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that fought at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the decisive engagement of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Rebellion and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In that battle, Blue Squad was one of multiple [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] squadrons that comprised the Alliance's [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Wing]] attack element.<ref name="Guide" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endorto]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Rebel Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] launched an attack on the Empire' [[Deflector shield/Legends|unshielded]] [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] over the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and called upon Blue Squad, along with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Groups]], to follow his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] towards the station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. However, beset by Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] as he made his approach, Calrissian ordered the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] "[[Blue Wing]],"<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> coordinator of the attack group of the same name,<ref name="Guide" /> to break formation and draw away the enemy craft. Calrissian's assault was a success, destroying the Death Star,<ref name="Novel" /> while Blue Squad's efforts contributed to the Rebel victory over the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MCQ-awing.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A pair of blue-colored A-wing starfighters, the craft flown by Blue Squad in the Battle of Endor.]]
Blue Squad first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] by [[James Kahn]],<ref name="Novel" /> published on [[May 12]], [[1983]].<ref name="Amazon">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> In addition to the ''Return of the Jedi'' novel, the [[1984]] reference book by [[Raymond L. Velasco]] ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' also cites ''[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Portfolio]]'' as a source for its "Blue Squad" entry.<ref name="Guide" /> Although the squad is not identified by name in the portfolio, a collection of [[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s concept art for the film released in 1983, one piece depicts a pair of A-wing starfighters with [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings.<ref name="Portfolio">''[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Portfolio]]''</ref>
